description: The formwav window. The engine-failure dialog and the bundled engine sidecar are run from Rust and need no permission here. The window shows the page the engine serves on 127.0.0.1, a remote origin to Tauri, so this capability lists that address (http://127.0.0.1:*) and the page may call exactly these and nothing else: the app commands app_ready (the page has drawn, the splash may end), set_window_title (the window title follows the page's), text_edit (the standard edit action to a focused text field) and set_menu (on macOS the page's menus, as labels, ids and shortcuts, go in the system menu bar; the page gets no menu API of Tauri's); the window calls minimize, toggle-maximize, maximize, unmaximize, is-maximized, close and start-dragging, for the Windows and Linux caption buttons and title bar drag; and listening for events, by which it hears the macOS menu (event fw-menu). The core defaults are deliberately not granted.
